kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Aug–11 Nov 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Capacity
info.definition: Working hours in the period, from the calendar (weekends, holidays and shorter days), less approved leave and permissions; counted from each person's hire date and until they were deactivated.
info.formula: Σ per person per working day: the day's hours − leave and permissions

kpis.label: Logged hours
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Aug–11 Nov 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Logged hours
info.definition: Every hour logged in the period by the people in view.

kpis.label: Utilisation
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Aug–11 Nov 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Utilisation
info.definition: Standard hours (all but production-day hours) as a share of capacity, for the people with capacity in the period. Nothing logged is "No data", never a good figure.

kpis.label: Over capacity
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Aug–11 Nov 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Over capacity
info.definition: People whose utilisation in the period is above the overload threshold in Settings.
info.formula: count of people with C3 > overload threshold

kpis.label: Free hours, next 8 weeks

info.name: Free hours, next 8 weeks
info.definition: Capacity in the next eight weeks less booked work (remaining estimates on dated, assigned tasks and upcoming retainer cycles) and likely deals, floored at zero person by person and week by week.
info.formula: Σ weekly max(0, capacity − booked − likely)
info.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.
